chapters: Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Moisees jix koi; gio ba' bamii' jano' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' gu Jordaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' dhagia' na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaas tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' dɨr oidha' jix gaki dhi' gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates bɨx gu oidha' gu eteos bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tas ka't pai'.

Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; gio ba' na ja'p tu' tu jiim bɨɨx gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨndak; mi' dhɨr cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' jix kavɨk; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tattat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jurtu'nka' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu duukam gu Moisees tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix duu.

Jano' ba' u'uan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chin; gio ba' va'k gu tanoolh gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak; na gu' jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt bɨx tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu Prebeniios jugi; na gu' tu jiim vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jordaan na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Josuee gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu vaakax guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' gu Moisees tu' jix maa dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx jix kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gio guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bhaan pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tas; mi' dhɨr bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee bham; gio ba' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix duu tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Moisees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' no'x ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun bhañ dɨr gu Sittim gook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu baap gu vaak gu u'vɨ ganai' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Raab guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap dhi' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Raab; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kia'mi'ñ gu vaak; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook gu chichio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'r gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs tu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios duukat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' jix duu ki'ñgob guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ moor cham tu' duukat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Gu' gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dua'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' ki'ñgob ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr moor bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Ba' jix aa' gu' va'k guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' choo'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan no'ch bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na pai' dhuuk oirɨ gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Seoon gu Og guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jiix gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu vaak gu taat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ nɨi'ñchudat dhuu.

Jano' ba' dodhia' gu oidha' gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam sɨspidhi'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam koi'm.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm koi'm tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' jix maa gu oidha' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaak jodai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaak jodai.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' jix duu gu kavɨk na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch duduaka' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na pai' dhuuk no'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu taat.

Jano' ba' no'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mai' kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o no'ch cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gu' no'x guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak bɨndak gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mo'o tu' gu novɨ kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu dhi' chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn no'ch duduaka' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix bɨɨx duu; jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñchu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' bhiadat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu' cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kavɨk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gio bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Josuee gu xibh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sittim tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios va'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam bham; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios pai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhiñ gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu'; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ va'k jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu bhóogɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu vaas tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Señoreador bɨx gu oidha' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n jiix guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gɨ' kavɨk.
