Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn pai' yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' ka't tɨɨgim gu Gilgal bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Gilgal guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xumai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gakdhi'ñchix koi'mɨk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu tanoolh kaipgaidhat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix utu'ñ gu tanoolh buimgidhak dɨr kua'da' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chooto'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat koi'mɨk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu Kanaan mii' dhɨr pai' tas.

Jano' ba' kua' gu Josuee mia'n gu Jerikoo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui jix ñi' gu chio'ñ ka't vupui bhaan ga'ra' gu kuchii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Josuee guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham; gu' gu Priinkipe ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios jano' tɨbiap; jano' ba' gu Josuee guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Priinkipe ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt; na gu' pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan; jano' ba' gu Josuee jix duu.
Gu' gu' gu Jerikoo ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xoi'kam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' busaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' mia'n kiicham bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiimchu' xikoolh kiicham tu jiim; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ a'aa' gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kuichdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook vaak jodai kiicham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨtaa'n; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa maa'n jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ a'aa' gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee ka't tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ a'aa' gu chuukug guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios xikoolh kiicham tɨɨtɨs vaak ja'tkam chooto'n gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix búup gu xibh jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ a'aa' gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham gook gu tanoolh suulh vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix búup na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham kɨɨv mui'kim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' gu tanoolh jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios xikoolh kɨɨv mui'kim.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan a'lhiok dhaa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' kiicham.

Gu' gu' kiicham ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x; na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Raab ganai' ii'mdagaram bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak bɨɨx na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kɇkɇɇda' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat yooxi' gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Gu' gu' bɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat chumñigam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu ja'tkam ka't naak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix maa gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaak jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham maa'n jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx kiicham ka't; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam nu'aa' bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax kakneer buur guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Josuee gook gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha'; gio ba' ba'k gu vaak gu u'vɨ ganai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'vɨ bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' biipibop guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam baap guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Raab gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam bɨx ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix dhaas mai' yooxi' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx gu tai kiicham bɨx ka't; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix dhaas chumñigam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai.

Gu' gu' gu Josuee guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Raab ganai' gu vaak gu taat bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israelitas bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu gu Josuee bhañ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jerikoo.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' kiicham gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr maa'nkam mar guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix ali' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Josuee gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu Akân gu mar gu Karmi gu mar gu Sabdi gu mar gu Sera bopxi'ñ gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee bhañ gu chichio'ñ dɨr gu Jerikoo gu ai ka't ju'ñdharan gu Bet-aben bhaan tas buusñi gu Bet-el; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Josuee gui'p; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx gu ja'tkam gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' na ja'p vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ai; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam na ja'p vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu ai.

Jano' ba' gu ai jix duu na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu chichio'ñ bhiadat dɨr ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu Sebarim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jajannulhi'ñ o'lhia'n gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Por guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jordaan na ba' kapbhai' gu noobh gu Amorreos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Ojalaa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na gu' na gu' gu Kananeos bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chulhiiñdha' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu tu' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' bamii'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' ka't jix duu; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' bamii' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' gu xibh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Israeel; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu xibh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak; jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ.

Na gu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tai bɨx juraa'n na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee kɨkbo gu xibh guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bopxi'ñ gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ja'tkam vaak gu Sera; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ja'tkam vaak gu Sera guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sabdi.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Akân gu mar gu Karmi gu mar gu Sabdi gu mar gu Sera bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu Akân; gio ba' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhai' ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Akân jix aa' gu Josuee bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhai' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨtaa'n gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel tuumiñ bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee jano' ba' bhañ jix duu jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak zel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak zel tuumiñ bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel aichdhak gu Josuee bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ gu Akân gu mar gu Sera tuumiñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix uam jodai gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu vaakax buur kakneer vaak zel bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' bhɨɨk bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akôr.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Tuurbete gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Israelitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai mi' dhɨr tu jiim bɨɨx gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'iich; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu Balle gu Akôr bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham jum i'obh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨndak bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bamii' tu jiim gu ai; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu ja'tkam kiicham gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ai gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaakax guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu ai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Josuee guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk bhañ gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix jai' kiicham dhi' bɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan no'ch na ja'p jix duu va'k guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kiicham; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan kiicham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu noobh.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tai; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bhañ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai tas gei'ñ gu ai; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu xibh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ai.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka't jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan kiicham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ai.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ja'p jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix dhaas guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai baasɨ'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kiicham.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx yooxi' ka't baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' mia'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tas gei'ñ kiicham suudai' u'va gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' gu ai jix búup guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu xibh jix buus bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kiicham bhaan gu Israeel bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios nɨi'ñchudat cham pu'ñir ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kiicham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ai jum daa'ñ na ba' jix duu; gio ba' bhiadat gu Josuee guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kiicham.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ gu ai gu Bet-el cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kiicham jix kupi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ bhaan gu ai na gu' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix búup bhaan kiicham u'u kavɨk gu novɨ ga'ra'.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa pai' mi'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ tɨɨtɨs kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam buuplhia' gu tai.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kiicham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuubh kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tɨkɨr cham chooto'n guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' baasɨ'n tu'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan oi'ñchu'.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel ñɨi'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham kuubh kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix duu gu ai.

Jano' ba' moor kiicham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel baasɨ'n; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' gu ai aichdhak gu Josuee.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israelitas jix bɨɨx duu kooda' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ai yooxi' oidha' jix gaki pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu Israelitas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ai gio jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ia'rɨ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' bɨx gu ai.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu novɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx u'u kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ai.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israelitas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' gu vaakax guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kiicham jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ai guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ai guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' na ja'p gu tas jix dhaas jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu gu chuukug guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ki'ñgob kiicham; mi' dhɨr jix búup bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Josuee jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Ebal.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai tu jiim bhaan soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' gio ua'na gu jodai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees ka't ua'nak vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel daraa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mi'p baasɨ'n ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu kavɨk gu Ebal; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu va'k na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ua'tulhi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' cham ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu Josuee cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel gu u'vɨ a'aalh jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' tu'x bɨx gu gɨ'kora' mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gɨ' kavɨk na ja'p guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' vupui bhaan gu Liibano gu eteos gu Amorreos gu Kananeos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Josuee tu' gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gabaoon na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Josuee ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jerikoo gu ai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn nu'aa' bhaan buur o'jo' nu'aa' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam nu'aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨɨt bɨɨx jajannulhi'ñ nu'aa' bhaan; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix gaki guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee yooxi' gu Gilgal gui'p gu Israeel; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jano' bɨɨx no'ch ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ebeos; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ no'ch guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee; gio ba' no'ch gu'ch tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix aa'; jano' ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat duukat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix duu gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't gu Astarot.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ daraa bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu noobh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'xñi; mi' dhɨr no'ch gu'ch tu duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jano' bɨɨx no'ch ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix tónom guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jano' jix gaki guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam o'jo' suudai' u'va gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xixiibkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr gio dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' nu'aa' kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu bhóogɨt cham tɨkka gu chin gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'; gio ba' gio chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaik gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gabaoon gu Kapira gu Beerot gu Kiriat-jearim.

Na gu' cham jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vaak jodai bhaan chiñia'.

Gu' gu' bɨx chiñia' tu ñi'ook bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kuichdha'.

Jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñchuda' bɨɨx; na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ duaka' na gu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan no'ch kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gu' ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p chiñia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Josuee bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham gu abitamos guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu u'u guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee gui'p; gio ba' na ja'p ka't jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees tu duukam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu oidha' ka't cham tu' duu bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix bhai' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam no'ch guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix duu; na guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p gu Adonisedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem jix kai gu Josuee ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ai ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gabaoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Israelitas mi'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chooto'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n; na gu' gu Gabaoon ka't kiicham na ja'p jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' gu ai bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Adonisedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu Oam gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu Piream gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu Japia gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu Debir gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Gabaoon; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Josuee bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx bɨx chugi'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bhaan gu Gabaoon guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gabaoon mɨjɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Josuee yooxi' gu Gilgal; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu noobh tu duukam; mi' dhɨr tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa no'ch na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Josuee gu Gilgal bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n; na gu' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee suudai' u'va guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu tukaa' jix tɨ'ɨ dɨr gu Gilgal.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan gu Israeel tu' naaka'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Gabaoon; gio ba' chɨ'ɨɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt tu jiim gu Bet-oron tu' naaka'n bɨɨx ka'm gu Aseka gu Makeda.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israelitas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Bet-oron gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu Aseka jix koko'; gio ba' mui'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix koko' gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Amorreo vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israelitas; gio ba' gu tas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Gabaoon; mi' dhɨr tu' gu masad guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Ajaloon.

Jano' ba' gu tas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu masad tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ua'nak u'uan gu Jaser gu tas tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka't tu jiim gu tanoolh va'k tu' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhaibu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ yooxi' gu Gilgal.
Gu' gu' jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' jiboi'ññor guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jumpa'n gu Makeda.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Josuee jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bakia' jumpa'n gu Makeda.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Rodad gu jodai gu chin jumpa'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham jix duu baakɨi jɨ'dɨlh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'lhiok gu ñi'ook jix ko'k bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ yooxi' gu Josuee gu Makeda; na cham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ nɨɨn bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chin jumpa'n jix buusñi dhi' ja'tkam jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jumpa'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon.

Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok jix buusñi dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu Josuee bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix dhaas tɨɨt bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr tu jiim jix kavɨk; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Josuee naaka'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jixchamaam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jumpa'n pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jix dhaas gu jodai gu chin jumpa'n bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee gu Makeda jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Makeda jix duu na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Makeda guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Libna; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Libna.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gio gu gɨ'kora' gu noobh gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii bɨɨx bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Libna gu Lakîs jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Lakîs gu novɨ gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh buimgidhak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Libna.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oram gu gɨ'kora' gu Geser jix tɨ'ɨ u'ua'tɨdham gu Lakîs; gu' gu ja'tkam naaka'n gu Josuee bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gu Lakîs guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Egloon; gio ba' jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Egloon gu ebroon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu'; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Egloon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx bhaan gu Debir guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ebroon jix duu gu Debir gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Libna gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Josuee bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gɨ' kavɨk saagi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu'; gio ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't jix duu.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Josuee dɨr gu Kades-barnea bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa bɨx gu oidha' gu Goseen bɨɨx ka'm gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee tu jiim; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx yooxi' gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu asor bhañ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jobab gu gɨ'kora' gu Madoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Simrom gu gɨ'kora' gu Aksap.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' mi'p baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gɨ' kavɨk tu jiim saagi'ñ gu Kinnerot guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Dor tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Kananeo ka't tas buusñi tas gei'ñ gu Amorreo gu eteo gu Pereseo gu Jebuseo gɨ' kavɨk gu ebeo bɨtaa'n gu ermoon gu oidha' gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam moor bɨɨx bɨx chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam jix jai' na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jum daa'ñ bai'ñpu' jum daa'ñ vaak ja'tkam ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Merom na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n gu xibh dhi' gu tas tu' kapbhai' bɨx suulhgia' koko'kam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josuee bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Merom.

Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Israeel jix duu bhiadat bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim gu Mispa tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee bɨɨx na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Josuee jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu asor tu' naaka'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu asor ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ va'k mo'o bɨx dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Asor jix dhaas gu tai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh mi'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Asor guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Josuee.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaakax guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh; gu' bɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oi'ñdha' bɨɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees tu duukam gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Josuee jix duu cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gɨ' kavɨk bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ saagi'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Goseen guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu kavɨk gu alak tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu Baal-gad guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Liibano guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu kavɨk gu ermoon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu gɨ'kora' naaka'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x gu tanoolh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Josuee bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' cham ka't kiicham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix buusñi gu ebeos guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Gabaoon; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Na gu' na gu' dhi' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel na ba' cham tu' duu cham jum duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch va'k bhaai'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va gu Josuee guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Anakeos gu kakkavɨk gu ebroon gu Debir gu Anab bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu Judaa bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Josuee guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Anakeos guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Gasa gu Gat gu Asdod.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx gu oidha' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees; gio ba' do'ñcho gu Josuee gu Israelitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix utu'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa baasɨ'n gu Jordaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tas dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu esboon aapi' dɨr gu Aroer guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon dɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Galaad bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jabok gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' dɨr vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinnerot tas buusñi; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado tas buusñi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Bet-jesimot; mi' dhɨr dɨr saagi'ñ bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pisga.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Rapeos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Astarot gu Edrei.
Jano' ba' aapi' gu kavɨk gu ermoon gu Salka bɨx gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Gessuri gu Maakâti tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Galaad gu oidha' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duu gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' naaka'n gu Josuee bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ dɨr gu Baal-gad tu jiim gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu alak tu jiim gu Seir; gio ba' gu oidha' jix maa gu Josuee gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu Israeel jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios oidha' jix gaki saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu eteo gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo maa'n; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jarmut; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Debir; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Geder.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu orma; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Libna; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Makeda; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tappua; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu eper.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Apek; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Lasaroon.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Madoon; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu asor.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Simrom-meron; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Aksap.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Taanak; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Megiddo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kêdes; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jokneam gu Karmel.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dor oidha' gɨ' gu Dor; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Gentes gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tirsa; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Josuee tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Pilisteos bɨx gu Gessuri.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu Sior vupui bhaan gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Akkaroon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Kananeos; gio ba' jixchamaam oidha' gɨ' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu Gaseos gu Asdodios gu Askalonitas gu Geteos gu Akkaronitas; jano' ba' gu ebeos.
Jano' ba' saagi'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Kananeos gu Meara gu Sidonios bɨɨx ka'm gu Apek bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Gibleos bɨx gu Liibano bhaan pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tas dɨr gu Baal-gad guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨɨx ka'm baakɨi gu amat.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gɨ' kavɨk dɨr gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu Sidonios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israelitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar na ja'p tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tu' jano' dhi' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Na gu' na gu' ɨraab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas jix maa gu Moisees baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi bhaan jix maa gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Medeba bɨɨx ka'm gu Diboon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix gɨ'kora' gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu Galaad guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Gessuri gu Maakâti bɨx gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨx gu oidha' gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salkâ.

Jano' ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan jix gɨ'kora' gu Astarot gu Edrei ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Rapeos; na gu' gu Moisees naaka'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu Gessuri gu Maakâti cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' va'k gu Gessur gu Maakât guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israelitas bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix maa gu maa'nkar; gio ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' dɨr gu Aroer jugii'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu Medeba.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' gu Diboon gu Bamot-baal gu Bet-baal-meoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jaas gu Keddemot gu Mepaat.
Jano' ba' gu Kîriataim gu Sibma gu Seretsaar gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-peor gu Asdot-pisga gu Bet-jesimot.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh vaak ja'tkam bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix gɨ'kora' gu esboon naaka'n gu Moisees chiñia' gu Madiaan gu ebi gu Rekem gu Sur gu ur gu Reba chiñia' gu Seoon oi'ñka' mii' dhɨr gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Balaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu mar gu Beor bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Moisees bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Gad jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' ka't gu Jaker guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Galaad tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Aroer vupui bhaan gu Rabba.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Ramatmispe gu Betonim; gio ba' dɨr gu Maanaim bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Debir.

Jano' ba' vaak ja'tkam gu Bet-aram gu Bet-nimra gu Sukot gu Sapoon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon; gio ba' gu Jordaan gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinneret baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Gad guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gio jix maa gu Moisees guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' ka't ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' ka't dɨr gu Maanaim bɨx gu Basaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ taañpu' gu Jair gu Basaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Galaad gu Astarot gu Edrei jɨ'dɨlh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Makîr jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Moisees guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Moab baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi.
Gu' gu' bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix maa gu Moisees gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees koi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ ka't gu Moisees jix maa gu maa'nkar baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gu' gu Lebitas cham jix maa gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Josee jix bɨɨx duu gook bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Epraim; gio ba' cham jix maa baasɨ'n gu Lebitas gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' ñɨidhat gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Kades-barnea guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Kades-barnea guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p ga'ra' gu i'ii'ñ.

Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨɨt cham ua'tulhi'ñ na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam duaka' na ja'p dhi' ja'tkam oo'm jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix kavɨk na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Moisees bhañ; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu kavɨk tu jiim jano' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' baakɨi.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jano' dhi' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Anakeos jix kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu ebroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ebroon ka't gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo gu maa'nkar bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ebroon ka't va'k mɨmɨim gu Kîriat-arba; gio ba' ka't gu Arba gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Anakeos; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jɨɨpi'ñka' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Edom oidha' jix gaki gu Sin saagi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' baasɨ'n saagi'ñ ka't dɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado dɨr nɨɨn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' busaak bhaan saagi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Akrabim bhɨi bɨɨx ka'm gu Sin; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ebroon guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Addar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Karka.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Asmoon busaak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Ejipto; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' gu oidha' tas gei'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu oidha' saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' tas buusñi gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu oidha' baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr nɨɨn gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' tu jiim dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Bet-ogla guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Bet-araba tu jiim dhi' gu oidha' gu jodai gu Boaan gu mar gu Rubeen.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' gu oidha' gu Debir dɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akôr; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan gu Gilgal vupui bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Adumin saagi'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' gu oidha' gu suudai' gu En-semes guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ suudai' buusñi gu Rogel.

Jano' ba' tu jiim dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu mar gu innom guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jebuseo saagi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr tu jiim dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu innom bhaan tas gei'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhi' gu oidha' dɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu Neptoa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk gu Eproon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Baala gu Kîriat-jearim.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu oidha' dɨr gu Baala bhaan tas gei'ñ gu kavɨk gu Seir; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk gu Jearim bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' gu Kesaloon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Bet-semes guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Timna.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ekroon bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha' gu Sikêron guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kavɨk gu Baala guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jabneel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' pai' gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tas gei'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gɨ'; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone jix maa baasɨ'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' dhi' gu Kîriat-arba gu taat gu Anak gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu Kaleb guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik gu ma'nkam gu Anak gu Sesai gu Aiman gu Talmai gu ma'nkam gu Anak.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Debir; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Debir ka't va'k gu Kîriat-seper.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaleb; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Kîriat-seper guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mar u'vɨ gu Axa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu Axa.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu taat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga buur; mi' dhɨr gu Kaleb jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' jix maa gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gio suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; jano' ba' jix maa suudai' buusñi jiix guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bhaan gu oidha' gu Edom saagi'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Eder gu Jagur.
Jano' ba' gu Kina gu Dimona gu Adada.
Jano' ba' gu Kedes gu Asor tu' gu Itnaan.
Jano' ba' gu Sip gu Telem gu Bealot.
Jano' ba' gu Asor-adatta gu Kêriot-esron gu Asor.
Jano' ba' gu Amam gu Sema gu Molada.
Jano' ba' gu Asar-gadda gu esmoon gu Bet-pelet.
Jano' ba' gu asar-sual gu Beerseba gu Bisotia.
Jano' ba' gu Baala tu' gu Iim gu Esem.
Jano' ba' gu Eltolad gu Kesil gu orma.
Jano' ba' gu Siklag gu Madmanna gu Sansana.
Jano' ba' gu Lebaot gu Silim gu Aiin gu Rimmoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Estaol gu Sorea gu Asena.
Jano' ba' gu Sanoa gu Engannim gu Tappua gu Enam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Adullam gu Sokô gu Akeka.
Jano' ba' gu Saraim gu Aditaim gu Gedera gu Gederotaim; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Senaan gu adasa gu Migdalgad.
Jano' ba' gu Dilaan gu Mispa gu Jokteel.
Jano' ba' gu Lakîs gu Boskat gu Egloon.
Jano' ba' gu Kaboon gu Lamas gu Kîtlis.
Jano' ba' gu Gedero gu Bet-dagoon gu Naama gu Makeda; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Libna gu Eter gu Asaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jipta gu Asna gu Nesib.
Jano' ba' gu Keila gu Aksib gu Maresa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Ekroon bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Ekroon bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Asdod bɨɨx taañpu'.

Jano' ba' gu Asdod bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn taañpu'; gio ba' gu Gasa bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn taañpu' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gɨ' kavɨk gu Samir gu Jattir gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' gu Danna gu Kîriat-sanna gu Debir.
Jano' ba' gu Anab gu Estemo gu Anim.
Jano' ba' gu Goseen gu Oloon gu Gilo; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Arab gu Duma gu Esaan.
Jano' ba' gu Janum gu Bet-tappua gu Apeka.
Jano' ba' gu umta gu Kîriat-arba gu ebroon gu Sior; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Maoon gu Karmel gu Sip gu Juta.
Jano' ba' gu Isreel gu Jokdeam gu Sanoa.
Jano' ba' gu Kaiin gu Gibea gu Timna; gio ba' mambhɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu alul gu Betpur gu Gedor.
Jano' ba' gu Maarat gu Bet-anot gu Eltekoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Kîriat-jearim gu Rabba; gio ba' gook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' oidha' jix gaki gu Bet-araba gu Middiin gu Sekâkâ.
Jano' ba' gu Nibsan kiicham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Engedi; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.

Gu' gu' gu Jebuseos oi'ñka' gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Judaa cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jebuseo gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Josee jix buus dɨr gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu Jerikoo bhaan tas buusñi oidha' jix gaki tu jiim gu Jerikoo gu kavɨk gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-el guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tasi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu Arki gu Atarot.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Japlet bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Bet-oron guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm gu Geser; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu Manasees gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim baasɨ'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dɨr gu Atarot-addar bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-oron jiix.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Mikmetat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix maa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' gu oidha' bhaan tas buusñi gu Tanat-silo guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tas buusñi gu Janoa.
Jano' ba' gu Janoa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Atarot gu Naarata guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerikoo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu Tappua guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu oidha' bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kana guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Epraim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gio jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Kananeo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Geser; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Kananeo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't bopxi'ñ.

Na gu' gu Tubo gio guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bopxi'ñ gu Manasees na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar gu Josee; gio ba' gu Makîr maa'nkam mar gu Manasees gu taat gu Galaad ka't gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Galaad gu Basaan.

Jano' ba' chooto'n gio guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Abieser gu ma'nkam gu elek gu ma'nkam gu Esriel gu ma'nkam gu Sikêm gu ma'nkam gu eper gu ma'nkam gu Semida; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Gu' gu' gu Salpaad gu mar gu eper gu mar gu Galaad gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milkâ gu Tirsa.

Jano' ba' dhi' tɨɨtɨs vupui bhaan gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun chiñia' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees koi guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu taat jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ia'rɨ gu Manasees mambhɨɨx mamai'chɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Basaan baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Na gu' na gu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Manasees guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Galaad ka't gu ma'nkam gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu Manasees dɨr gu Aser bɨɨx ka'm gu Mikmetat vupui bhaan gu Sikêm; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu oidha' gu novɨ jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Tappua.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Tappua ka't gu Manasees; gu' gu Tappua ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Manasees gu ma'nkam gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kana bhaan saagi'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh gu Epraim tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Manasees; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Manasees dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ' suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu Epraim saagi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu Aser baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu Issakâr tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat vaik gu chio'ñ bopxi'ñ na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jurtu'nka' dɨppɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'.
