Jano' ba' gu oidha' ka't gu elkât gu alii gu Beteen gu Axap.
Jano' ba' gu Alammelek gu Amead gu Miseal; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu Karmel tas gei'ñ gu Sior-libnat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tas gu Bet-dagoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sabuloon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Iptael guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Bet-emek gu Neiel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Kabul o'nsop.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ebroon gu Reob gu ammoon gu Kana bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu oidha' gu orma bɨɨx ka'm jix kavɨk kiicham gu Tiro guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu oidha' gu osa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Aksib.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gio gu Umma gu Apek gu Reob; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aser guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' dɨr gu elep gu Alloon-saananim gu Adami-nekeb gu Jabneel bɨɨx ka'm gu Lakum; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu oidha' bhaan tas gei'ñ gu Asnot-tabor guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ukuka guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu Sabuloon saagi'ñ tas gei'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx gu Aser bɨɨx gu Judaa gu Jordaan bhaan pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tas.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Siddim gu Ser gu amat gu Rakkat gu Kinnerot.
Jano' ba' gu Adama gu Rama gu Asor.
Jano' ba' gu Kedes gu Edrei gu En-asor.
Jano' ba' gu Iroon gu Migdalel gu orem gu Bet-anat gu Bet-semes; gio ba' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix buus guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Sora gu Estaol tu' gu Ir-semes.
Jano' ba' gu Saalabiin gu Ailoon gu Jet-la.
Jano' ba' gu Eloon gu Timnata gu Ekroon.
Jano' ba' gu Eltekê gu Gibbetoon gu Baalat.
Jano' ba' gu Jeud gu Bene-beraak gu Gat-rimmoon.
Jano' ba' gu Mejarkoon gu Rakkoon bɨɨx gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Joppa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Dan; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Dan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Lesem guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Lesem gu Dan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan gu taat.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kiicham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' dɨppɨr gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat kapbhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' nɨi'ñchudat jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees.

Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mua'kam kooda' oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mia'n jix koi.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ki'ñgob kiicham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn baidhak tu jiim kiicham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mia'n jix koi guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham kapbhai' gu novɨ mua'kam na gu' naaka'n tɨtmo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx va'k guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr kiicham bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm koi'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jano' ba' mua'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ɨlhdham kiicham gu vaak kiicham pai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu Kedes gu Galilea gu kavɨk gu Neptalii gu Sikêm gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu Kîriat-arba gu ebroon gu kavɨk gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi nɨi'ñchudat gu Beser oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Ramot gu Galaad bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Gauloon gu Basaan bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh nɨi'ñchudat na ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam no'x guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham vaak jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ mia'n jix koi bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tattat gu Lebitas tɨɨtɨs gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees bhaai'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu Lebitas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix buus guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Koatitas; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lebitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Simeoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Epraim bopxi'ñ gu Dan ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr bopxi'ñ gu Aser bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Basaan jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Gad guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon.

Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Lebitas dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix maa dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon ja'tkam vaak gu Koat gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Kîriat-arba gu taat gu Anak gu ebroon gu kavɨk gu Judaa bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Gu' gu' yooxi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kiicham taañpu' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ebroon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' gu Libna bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jattir bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Estemoa bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu eloon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Debir bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Ain bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jutta bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bet-semes bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' gook bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Gibeoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Geba bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Anatot bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Almoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu Lebitas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Koat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bopxi'ñ gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Sikêm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu Geser bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Kibsaim bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bet-oron bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu Elteko bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Gibetoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Ayaloon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Taanak bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' gook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebitas jix maa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Gauloon gu Basaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bosra bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr gook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu Kesioon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Daberet bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Jarmut bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu En-gannim bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu Miseal bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Abdoon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu elkât bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Reob bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Kedes gu Galilea bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ammot-dor bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kartaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' vaik guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Gersonitas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Lebitas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon gu Jokneam bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Karta bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Dimna bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Naalal bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Beser bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jasa bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Kedemot bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Mepaat bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Maanaim bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jaker bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Merari guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Lebitas jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mamai'chɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh mi'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xikoolh; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' xikoolh jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tattat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duu.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam dhi' ja'tkam mui'x gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak zel gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na kai'chɨt gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu bhóogɨt; na guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Josuee bhañ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu vaak zel.

Jano' ba' gio ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees ka't jix maa gu Moisees gu maa'nkar gu Basaan; gu' ɨraab jix maa gu Josuee gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ; mi' dhɨr gio suulhgia' bhañ gu Josuee vaak zel mi' dhɨr tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vaak zel bɨɨx namkɨm bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaakax bɨɨx jix toja jodai bɨɨx jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mui'x jajannulhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Galaad pai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bia'ka' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jum daa'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel maa'n ka't mo'o ja'tkam vaak tattat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu oidha' gu Galaad; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Peor cham dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios; gu' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu xibh tu jiim bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel.

Na tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Akân gu mar gu Sera guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees tu ñi'ook gui'p gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm choo'n dhi' bham; gio ba' gu xibh gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim namki' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu Jordaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu' gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' cham namki' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duu jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan cham na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' na ba' gu maa'nkar.

Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' ka't chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ aajim mi' dhɨr no'ch guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu xibh gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham namki' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim no'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat cham na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' jum duu chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pinees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel bɨɨx mi'p gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Pinees gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Manasees; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar chiñia' suulh bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu oidha' gu Galaad gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' cham tu' duu gu oidha' oi'ñka' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mui'x gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Israeel bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Josuee guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt bɨx gu Israeel daraa chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' bopxi'ñ dhi' chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dɨr gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan pai' gu tas guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bia'ka' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix jai' nukadham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ba'k dhi' chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' tu' baas gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ soo'mchulhdhak tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mambhɨɨx gɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p jix aa'.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix jai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu i'ii'ñ kai'chɨt gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ba'k guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' va'k ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jo'ii' na ba' gu vupui bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' dhi' na ba' baakɨi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu'.

Gu' gu' ka't na ja'p tu' tɨbiap bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu bhaan jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu jiimchu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix bhai' gu oidha' tu' jix maa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josuee guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Sikêm jup tɨɨt daraa gu Israeel chiñia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tattat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim maachim gu Taree gu taat gu Abraam gu Nakôr; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu taat gu Abraam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu Kanaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' gu Isaak tu' gu Jakob gu Esauu; gio ba' gu Esauu tu' gu kavɨk gu Seir guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gu' gu Jakob gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim gu Moisees gu Aaroon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Ejipto guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tattat gu Ejipto; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ' suudai' gu Egipkios bhiadat tattat bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kavaayo.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu tukgam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Egipkios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' jix bhaan dhaas; gio ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mui'x gu tanoolh oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' gu Amorreos oi'ñka' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jix búup mi' dhɨr gu Balak gu mar gu Sepor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moabitas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' bhañ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix kai gu Balaam va'k jix bhai' aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu noobh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jordaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jerikoo; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerikoo guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr gu Amorreos gu Pereseos gu Kananeos gu eteos gu Gergeseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos; jano' ba' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maachim gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos; gio ba' cham bɨɨx gu kuchii tu' bɨɨx u'u gat.

Jano' ba' tu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'r; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tattat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ chɨkka guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tattat na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Amorreos gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na tu' gu vaak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi no'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak juantu'n; gio ba' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' buimɨk tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan no'ch bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Amorreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha'; na gu' no'ch gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duu; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' cham va'k gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu duu; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu'ch.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Josuee ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh jix dhaas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Sikêm.

Jano' ba' ua'na gu Josuee dhi' gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhaagɨk jix gɨ' gu jodai jix búup bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't ju'ñdharan xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu jodai ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ookdham tu' naak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch; na gu' ka't ñi'ookdham bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Josuee gu ja'tkam maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x jix koi gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chamaam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu kavɨk gu Gaas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josuee bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios daraa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mi' dhɨr gu Josuee guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sikêm o'oo gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Ejipto baasɨ'n yooxi' gu Jakob guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ma'nkam gu emor gu taat gu Sikêm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ali' karneer; gio ba' ka't gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Josee.
Jano' ba' gio jix koi gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Pinees gu mar ka't jix maa gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
